name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, A New Plague begins with blood taken from darkhounds. Apothecary Johaan gathers the samples for the Royal Apothecary Society, acting on Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s command.

sections.title: A Royal Mandate
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan works in Brill for the Royal Apothecary Society, under orders from the Dark Lady. Sylvanas Windrunner has charged her alchemists with making a disease unlike any Azeroth has known. The original Plague of Undeath served the Lich King, slaughtering humanity and binding their souls. This new plague is meant to annihilate Arthas Menethil and lay waste to his Scourge legions.

sections.title: Raw Ingredients
sections.body: Johaan needs grim experiments to develop a weapon against the undead. He believes the blood of native beasts may hold useful chemical properties, beginning with darkhounds roaming Tirisfal Glades. You gather vials of their tainted blood so Johaan can isolate elements and test whether the beasts' resilience and predatory nature can help create a lethal contagion.

faq.q: What is the goal of the new plague?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas tasked the Royal Apothecary Society with brewing a disease deadlier than any other on Azeroth. Its aim is the destruction of Arthas and his Scourge army.
Johaan is a member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Brill. He conducts early field experiments, testing compounds gathered from Tirisfal's local beasts.

faq.q: Why does Johaan need darkhound blood?
faq.answer: Johaan believes native beasts' blood may provide a foundation for his alchemical formulas. He needs darkhound blood to test his early theories in the laboratory.

faq.q: How does this plague differ from the Scourge's plague?
faq.answer: The original Plague of Undeath was made by the Lich King to slaughter the living and bind their souls. Sylvanas's new plague is meant to bring ruin to Arthas's undead legions.

faq.q: Who ordered the creation of this plague?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner directly ordered the Royal Apothecary Society to create the plague. She believes Forsaken alchemy combined with newfound magic can defeat Arthas.

faq.q: What happens after gathering the blood?
faq.answer: Gathering darkhound blood begins a series of experiments. Johaan uses the samples to refine the pathogen through further field tests across the Glades.

angles.text: As an undead, you make your first direct contribution to the Royal Apothecary Society's project: creating the weapon Sylvanas plans to wield against Arthas.
As a member of the Horde, you stand beside the Forsaken, whose alchemical work in Tirisfal focuses on a grim weapon aimed at Northrend.
